summary_en: GNI Group to acquire 100% of Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings and consolidate as wholly-owned subsidiary. Deal rationale: capture Japanese market commercial platform, diversify revenue base, and integrate Ayumi's strong franchise (including Calpol analgesic) with GNI's China/US pharma pipeline. Concurrent third-party capital allocation to BCP Asia AYM Holding, Toho Holdings, and Hisao Pharmaceutical (existing Ayumi shareholders).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of All Shares of Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd. (Consolidation as Wholly-Owned Subsidiary) and Issuance of New Shares via Third-Party Allocation (In-Kind Contribution)
translation_en_brief:
On 5 June 2026, GNI Group's board resolved to acquire all shares of Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd. and consolidate it as a wholly-owned subsidiary, effective immediately. Concurrently, GNI will issue new shares via third-party allocation to three existing Ayumi shareholders: BCP Asia AYM Holding (Cayman) L.P. (70% of Ayumi), Toho Holdings Co., Ltd. (20%), and Hisao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (10%).

Ayumi Pharmaceutical operates as a holding company for Ayumi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., which manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals focused on anti-rheumatic drugs and analgesics, including the flagship Calpol brand. The company maintains strong distribution networks in Japanese healthcare facilities and holds leading market positions in orthopedic and rheumatology segments. FY26/3 consolidated revenue was ¥38.5 billion with operating profit of ¥6.2 billion.

GNI stated the acquisition supports its strategy to establish a stable Japanese earnings base while leveraging its internal pipeline from US and China operations and international biosimilar networks to expand Ayumi's product portfolio. No share count, acquisition price, or standalone valuation was disclosed in the two-page extract provided.
